### B1 — Server helpers

- `lib/context/active-location.ts` (NEW): `getActiveLocation(studioId)` returns `{ locationId, location, allLocations }`.

### B2 — API routes
- `app/api/context/set-studio/route.ts`: POST body `{ studioId }`, validate membership, set `inkos_active_studio` cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, 1-year, Secure in prod). Clear location cookie. Return `{ ok: true }`.
- `app/api/context/set-location/route.ts`: POST body `{ locationId: string | null }`, derive studioId from cookie (NOT request body — security), validate location belongs to studio, set cookie.

### B3 — Components
- `components/shared/StudioSwitcher.tsx`: 32px pill, ChevronsUpDown icon, base-ui DropdownMenu. Only renders when `allMemberships.length >= 2`. Per Vega §4 exact styling.
- `components/shared/LocationSwitcher.tsx`: 32px pill, MapPin + ChevronDown, "All locations" row for owner/admin. Only renders when `>= 2` locations.
- `components/shared/StudioParamSync.tsx`: tiny client component (`'use client'`) that reads `?studio=X` from `useSearchParams` and POSTs to set-studio if different from current. Renders null. Per Vega spec — this is how we avoid reading searchParams in layout.

### B4 — Header integration
- `components/app/sidebar/AppHeader.tsx`: insert `<StudioSwitcher>` + `<LocationSwitcher>` into breadcrumb area (left side). Switchers replace the first breadcrumb crumb when they render (per Vega §6). On mobile (below md), switchers hide from header — they appear in MobileNav sheet header instead (also spec'd).

### B5 — Layout integration
- `app/(app)/layout.tsx`: replace inline `.limit(1).single()` with `getActiveStudio()` call. Fetch active location separately. Thread active studioId + activeLocationId to AppSidebar / AppHeader.
- Mount `<StudioParamSync>` inside the layout so URL param sync works without layout reading search params directly.

### B6 — Downstream scoping (best-effort)
- Audit 3-5 critical API routes: if they use a hardcoded first-membership pattern, swap to `getActiveStudio()`. Examples to check:
  - `app/api/dashboard/kpis/route.ts`
  - `app/api/calendar/export/route.ts`
  - `app/api/bookings/route.ts`
- Don't refactor every route — just make sure the ones that DON'T use `getAuthenticatedUser` get the cookie-aware version.

### B7 — MobileNav switchers
Per Vega §10: on mobile, put the StudioSwitcher + LocationSwitcher in the MobileNav sheet header (between user info and nav groups). Hide them from the header row on mobile.

### B8 — `/dev/design` Section 25
Preview of StudioSwitcher + LocationSwitcher + AppHeader composite with both active.

## Hard rules
- Base-ui `render={<X/>}` pattern
- `exactOptionalPropertyTypes: true` conditional spread
- 0 raw hex (except brand) / 0 default shadows / 0 `any` / 0 `console.*`
- Don't break S13 / S14 redirects
- Cookie: `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Lax`, `Path=/`, `Secure` only in prod (`NODE_ENV === 'production'`)
- RLS already enforces studio isolation — trust it, but still validate membership before setting the cookie (defense in depth)

## Acceptance
```bash
rm -rf .next && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint --max-warnings=0 && pnpm build
```
Plus:
- User with 1 studio: no switcher renders
- User with 2+ studios (manually insert second membership for testing): switcher appears, click different studio → POST → `router.refresh()` → UI updates with new studio's data
- Active studio persists across browser reloads
- Deep-link `?studio=<uuid>` from shared email sets the cookie and renders with that studio
- Single-location studio: no LocationSwitcher
- Multi-location: LocationSwitcher appears, scoping works

3. `feat(api): context/set-studio + context/set-location POST routes`

5. `feat(shared): LocationSwitcher component`
6. `refactor(layout): (app)/layout uses getActiveStudio — lift .limit(1) limit`
7. `feat(header): insert switchers into AppHeader breadcrumb area + mobile MobileNav header`
8. `refactor(api): 3-5 critical routes use getActiveStudio() for cookie-aware scoping`
9. `feat(dev): /dev/design Section 25 Switchers`

Each commit: typecheck + lint + build clean.

Final push: `git push origin main`.

Single-studio users see zero change. Multi-studio users get `StudioSwitcher`; multi-location studios get `LocationSwitcher`. Active context is resolved server-side via cookies, with URL param override for deep links. 11 12 No new pages. No new routes other than two `POST` API handlers. The visible change is entirely within the `h-14` header bar that already exists. 13 14 --- 15 16 ## 1. Type Definitions 17 18 These shared types flow from `lib/context/active-studio.ts` and `lib/context/active-location.ts` to both server layout and client switcher components. 19 20 ```ts 21 // lib/context/active-studio.ts — export types inline 22 23 import type { Database } from '@/lib/supabase/types' 24 25 export type StudioRow = Database['public']['Tables']['studios']['Row'] 26 export type StudioMemberRow = Database['public']['Tables']['studio_members']['Row'] 27 export type StudioMemberRole = StudioMemberRow['role'] 28 // 'owner' | 'admin' | 'artist' | 'receptionist' | 'guest_artist' 29 30 export interface StudioMembership { 31 studioId: string 32 studio: StudioRow 33 role: StudioMemberRole 34 /** Resolved subscription plan for this studio. Defaults 'solo' if no active sub. */ 35 plan: import('@/lib/billing/feature-gate').PlanTier 36 } 37 38 export interface ActiveStudioContext { 39 studioId: string 40 studio: StudioRow 41 role: StudioMemberRole 42 plan: import('@/lib/billing/feature-gate').PlanTier 43 allMemberships: StudioMembership[] 44 } 45 ``` 46 47 ```ts 48 // lib/context/active-location.ts — export types inline 49 50 import type { Database } from '@/lib/supabase/types' 51 52 export type LocationRow = Database['public']['Tables']['locations']['Row'] 53 54 export interface ActiveLocationContext { 55 /** null means "All locations" view */ 56 locationId: string | null 57 location: LocationRow | null 58 allLocations: LocationRow[] 59 } 60 ``` 61 62 --- 63 64 ## 2. Server Helpers 65 66 ### `lib/context/active-studio.ts` 67 68 **Resolution order:** 69 1. URL search param `studio` (passed in from page search params, not directly readable in layout — read from `headers()` referer OR pass via a wrapper; see implementation note) 70 2. Cookie `inkos_active_studio` (httpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Max-Age 31536000) 71 3. First membership ordered by `studio_members.created_at ASC` 72 73 **Implementation note for URL param:** `app/(app)/layout.tsx` is a server component. It can read cookies but not URL search params directly (search params are available to `page.tsx`, not `layout.tsx`). Koda must pass the studio param via a client-side bootstrap on first render, OR implement in a route handler. The simplest correct path: in `layout.tsx`, read only cookie + fallback. The URL param `?studio=X` is honoured by having the user's browser POST to `/api/context/set-studio` on page load via a tiny `` client component (see Section 6). 74 75 **Validation:** after resolving studioId from any source, confirm the user has a `studio_members` row for it. If validation fails: clear cookie, fall back to first membership. 76 77 **Pseudocode shape:** 78 ```ts 79 export async function getActiveStudio(): Promise 80 // Called in app/(app)/layout.tsx. 81 // Uses: createClient() from lib/supabase/server.ts 82 // Reads: await cookies() → inkos_active_studio value 83 // Query: SELECT all studio_members + studios join for user, ordered by created_at ASC 84 // Returns: resolved ActiveStudioContext 85 // Side effect: none (does NOT write cookie — cookie write happens in /api/context/set-studio) 86 ``` 87 88 **What replaces in layout.tsx:** the current `memberResult` Promise.all branch. The new call is: 89 ```ts 90 const activeStudio = await getActiveStudio() 91 const { studioId, studio, role, plan, allMemberships } = activeStudio 92 ``` 93 The subscription query and locationCount query stay in layout.tsx (or move inside getActiveStudio — Koda's call for colocation). 94 95 ### `lib/context/active-location.ts` 96 97 **Resolution order:** 98 1. Cookie `inkos_active_location` (httpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Max-Age 31536000) 99 2. Studio's primary location (`is_primary = true`) 100 3. First location ordered by `sort_order ASC, created_at ASC` 101 4. `null` (all-locations view) 102 103 **Validation:** location must belong to the active `studioId`. If stale/invalid: clear cookie, fall back. 104 105 **"All locations" eligibility:** only `owner` and `admin` roles may select `null`. For `artist`, `receptionist`, `guest_artist`: fall back to their assigned location (query `location_artists` or equivalent join). If no assignment exists, default to first location. 106 107 ```ts 108 export async function getActiveLocation(studioId: string): Promise 109 // Reads: await cookies() → inkos_active_location value 110 // Query: SELECT all locations WHERE studio_id = studioId ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at ASC 111 // Returns: ActiveLocationContext 112 ``` 113 114 --- 115 116 ## 3. API Routes 117 118 ### `app/api/context/set-studio/route.ts` 119 120 ``` 121 Method: POST 122 Auth: Authenticated user (createClient() — RLS applies) 123 Body: { studioId: string } 124 Zod: z.object({ studioId: z.string().uuid() }) 125 ``` 126 127 **Steps:** 128 1. Parse + validate body with Zod. Return 400 on failure. 129 2. Verify membership: `supabase.from('studio_members').select('id').eq('user_id', user.id).eq('studio_id', studioId).single()`. If no row: 403. 130 3. Set cookie `inkos_active_studio` = studioId via `cookies().set(...)` in a `NextResponse`. 131 4. Clear cookie `inkos_active_location` (set Max-Age=0 or delete). Forces fresh location resolution under the new studio. 132 5. Return `NextResponse.json({ ok: true })`. 133 134 **Cookie spec:** 135 ``` 136 Name: inkos_active_studio 137 Value: 138 HttpOnly: true 139 SameSite: Lax 140 Path: / 141 Max-Age: 31536000 (1 year) 142 Secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' 143 ``` 144 145 ### `app/api/context/set-location/route.ts` 146 147 ``` 148 Method: POST 149 Auth: Authenticated user 150 Body: { locationId: string | null } 151 Zod: z.object({ locationId: z.string().uuid().nullable() }) 152 ``` 153 154 **Steps:** 155 1. Parse + validate. 156 2. If `locationId` is non-null: verify `supabase.from('locations').select('id').eq('id', locationId).eq('studio_id', activeStudioId).single()`. Derive `activeStudioId` from cookie (not body — never trust client for studio scope). If mismatch: 403. 157 3. If `locationId` is null: verify user role is `owner` or `admin`. If not: 403. 158 4. Set cookie `inkos_active_location` = locationId (or delete if null — use Max-Age=0 for null). 159 5. Return `NextResponse.json({ ok: true })`. 160 161 **Cookie spec:** 162 ``` 163 Name: inkos_active_location 164 Value: (absent when "All locations") 165 HttpOnly: true 166 SameSite: Lax 167 Path: / 168 Max-Age: 31536000 169 Secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' 170 ``` 171 172 --- 173 174 ## 4. `` Client Component (URL deep-link support) 175 176 Path: `components/shared/StudioParamSync.tsx` 177 178 **Purpose:** reads `?studio=X` from URL on mount, fires POST to set-studio if it differs from current active studio, then calls `router.refresh()`. This is how deep links from emails work. 179 180 ```ts 181 'use client' 182 // Props: currentStudioId: string 183 // On mount: read window.location.search → URLSearchParams.get('studio') 184 // If present AND !== currentStudioId: 185 // POST /api/context/set-studio { studioId } 186 // On success: router.refresh() (which also removes the param from visible URL via router.replace) 187 // Renders: null (invisible) 188 ``` 189 190 Inserted in `app/(app)/layout.tsx` as a sibling of `AppSidebar`, passing `studioId` as `currentStudioId`. 191 192 --- 193 194 ## 5. `` Component 195 196 **Path:** `components/shared/StudioSwitcher.tsx` 197 198 **Render condition:** only mount when `allMemberships.length >= 2`. When 1 membership, the caller renders a plain `BreadcrumbLink` instead (see Section 6). 199 200 **This is a Client Component** (`'use client'`). It receives all memberships as props (serializable plain objects). 201 202 ### Props 203 204 ```ts 205 interface StudioSwitcherProps { 206 currentStudioId: string 207 allMemberships: StudioMembership[] 208 // StudioMembership: { studioId, studio: StudioRow, role, plan } 209 } 210 ``` 211 212 ### Trigger pill 213 214 ``` 215 Height: h-8 (32px) 216 Max-width: max-w-[200px] 217 Padding: px-2 gap-1.5 218 Border-radius: rounded-lg 219 Border: border border-border/60 220 Background: bg-transparent hover:bg-muted/50 221 Transition: transition-colors duration-100 222 ``` 223 224 Contents (left to right): 225 - Studio logo OR monogram (see below): `h-5 w-5 shrink-0` 226 - Studio name: `text-[13px] font-medium text-foreground truncate` 227 - `ChevronsUpDown` icon (lucide): `h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground/50 shrink-0` 228 229 **Logo vs monogram logic:** 230 - If `studio.logo_url` is non-null: `` with `h-5 w-5 rounded object-cover` 231 - Else: `` with first 2 chars of studio name uppercased, `h-5 w-5 rounded bg-primary/10 text-primary text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center justify-center shrink-0` 232 233 **Accessibility:** 234 - `

1	# InkOS — Sidebar Consolidation + Tenant Switcher + Settings Redesign
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	The 12-sprint hardening program shipped. Post-launch usability review surfaces three linked problems in the app shell:
6	
7	1. **Sidebar is too dense.** Owner on Pro sees **31 items across 9 groups** (nav-config audit). Cognitive load is high; new users can't find what they need. Competitors show 6–10 top-level items, surface sub-features via in-page tabs.
8	
9	2. **Settings is fragmented.** 13 separate `/settings/*` routes, most with their own sidebar entry. This violates the Stripe / Vercel / Linear pattern (single settings route with internal sub-nav).
10	
11	3. **No tenant switcher.** `studio_members` is N:M but `app/(app)/layout.tsx` loads only the first membership (`.limit(1).single()`). A user who owns/joins a second studio cannot reach it. InkOS also has multi-location support (`locations` table) with zero UI to switch between locations.
12	
13	**User framing:** "Rankora has a workspace switcher at the top — does InkOS need one?" Rankora's switcher is **feature-based** (Hiring vs Agency — two apps in one shell), not multi-tenant. For InkOS, two distinct needs exist:
14	
15	- **Studio switcher** — real multi-tenant, for users with >1 studio membership (db already supports; UI missing).
16	- **Location switcher** — within a studio, for the location-aware views (calendar, inventory, bookings).
17	
18	**Goal:** Addictively simple navigation — 7–9 top-level items, everything else surfaces as tabs on the destination page. Production-grade, competitor-beating (Stripe / Linear / Fresha / Notion level).
19	
20	---
21	
22	## Design Decisions (locked)
23	
24	### 1. Navigation consolidation: 31 items → 8 top-level
25	
26	**New sidebar structure:**
27	
28	```
29	HOME
30	  • Dashboard
31	
32	SCHEDULE
33	  • Calendar
34	  • Appointments          (tab inside: All • Today • Waitlist)
35	  • Booking page
36	
37	CLIENTS
38	  • Clients               (tab inside: All • Tags • AI design • Consent forms)
39	
40	TEAM
41	  • Artists               (tab inside: Roster • Schedules • Guest artists • Permissions)
42	
43	MONEY                    (everything financial collapses here)
44	  • Payments
45	  • Commissions
46	  • Payroll
47	  • Reports
48	
49	MARKETING
50	  • Campaigns
51	  • Referrals
52	
53	INVENTORY
54	  • Inventory             (tab inside: Stock • Ink registry)
55	
56	SETTINGS                 (single top-level entry — see §3)
57	```
58	
59	**Result:** 8 groups, **13 sidebar items** (down from 31). Everything else becomes in-page tabs.
60	
61	Plan-gated items keep their current gating (Pro / Studio / Enterprise) — shown with badge, not hidden. Role-gated items remain role-filtered.
62	
63	### 2. Top-bar tenant switcher
64	
65	**What gets built:** A unified "context switcher" in the header left (next to the breadcrumb) that adapts to what the user has:
66	
67	- **Single studio + single location** (most users) → switcher is hidden; shows only the studio name as a breadcrumb crumb
68	- **Single studio + multiple locations** → Location pill only ("Downtown Studio ▾")
69	- **Multiple studios** → Studio pill ("Ink Haus ▾") that opens a dropdown of all studios; optionally also Location pill if the active studio has >1 location
70	
71	**Not a Rankora-style feature switcher.** Rankora switches between two app modes — InkOS has one app, multiple tenants.
72	
73	**Data:** lift the `.limit(1).single()` in `app/(app)/layout.tsx` → fetch all `studio_members` for the user. Track active studio in an `X-Active-Studio` cookie (or URL segment for better deep-linking — see implementation plan §3.2).
74	
75	### 3. Settings: 13 routes → 1 hub route with internal nav
76	
77	**New structure:**
78	
79	```
80	/settings                  (default: redirects to /settings/studio)
81	  Left sidebar 240px (internal to /settings):
82	    Studio
83	      • Profile
84	      • Branding
85	      • Services
86	      • Booking policies
87	      • Ink registry
88	      • Booking page
89	    Team
90	      • Members
91	      • Roles & permissions
92	    Subscription
93	      • Plan & billing
94	      • Usage
95	    Integrations
96	      • Connected apps
97	    Account                 (per-user, not per-studio)
98	      • My profile
99	      • Advanced
100	```
101	
102	Each sub-page is its own route (`/settings/studio/profile`, etc.) so direct links work. But the shell (sidebar within /settings) is shared — matches Stripe / Vercel.
103	
104	**Current pages keep their files** but get reorganized:
105	- `/settings/page.tsx` becomes a hub that redirects to `/settings/studio/profile`
106	- Each sub-page stays where it is (or moves one directory deeper) with a `SettingsLayout` wrapper
107	
108	---
109	
110	## Competitive Benchmarks (the bar)
111	
112	| Pattern | Primary |
113	|---|---|
114	| Sidebar density (8 top-level, sub-features as tabs) | **Linear** (7 top-level), **Notion** (5 workspace sections) |
115	| Settings hub with internal sub-nav | **Stripe**, **Vercel**, **Linear**, **Notion** |
116	| Tenant switcher (multi-workspace) | **Linear** workspace picker, **Notion** workspace picker, **Stripe** account switcher |
117	| Location switcher (within tenant) | **Fresha** location picker, **Square Dashboard** location picker |
118	| Badge for plan-gated items | **Vercel** Pro/Team badges, **Linear** upgrade prompts |
119	
120	---

129	- Move `Artists`, `Guest Artists`, `Schedules`, `Role Permissions` into a `Team` hub with tabs
